selected.title: FedNow to enable cross-border payments
selected.summary: The US Federal Reserve is pushing ahead with plans to enable participants in its FedNow real-time payments system to make cross-border transfers.
selected.why: Major expansion of FedNow real-time payments system to cross-border transfers.

reason: FedNow cross-border expansion raises concrete questions about whether real-time payments should remain domestic or go global, with tradeoffs in financial stability, sovereignty, and competition.
angle: Cross-border real-time payments risk fragmenting the dollar's settlement advantage unless the Fed strictly controls access.
